_status: PROTOCOL v1.0 - frozen 2026-10-17 before any M1-M4 training. Items marked APPROVAL_REQUIRED must be approved by the author before training starts. Any later change is a recorded deviation.

data.raw_data_reverification: APPROVAL_REQUIRED/OPEN: rerun Paper 1 tests/test_data.py and rebuild both tables from raw files on a machine with server access; tables must match the sha256 above

folds.inner_selection: leave-one-Re_tau-out over the four training cases of each outer fold
folds.E2: tune by leave-one-out over all five LM cases, refit on all five, test on the four HJ cases

time_scale.note: tau = max(k/eps, C_T sqrt(nu/eps)); C_T = 6 is the v2-f value (Durbin 1995) per a secondary source; primary-source confirmation OPEN

inputs.M1_M3_inputs: 16 Cartesian inputs: b_ij (6 independent), tau*dU_i/dx_j (9), Re_t; standardised with training-fold statistics (zero-variance columns: sd = 1)
inputs.M2_M4_inputs: invariant set P1 = [tr b^2, tr b^3, tr S*^2, tr bS*, tr bS*W*, tr bW*^2] + Re_t; standardised with training-fold statistics
inputs.target: Pi_ij/eps, full symmetric tensor; loss and metrics in Frobenius form (off-diagonal counted twice)
inputs.weights: grid-spacing weights, each Re_tau case sums to one (Paper 1 Section 7.4)

M2.representation: sum_{n=0..8} g_n(I) B_n, B_0 = identity, B_1..8 = raw (non-deviatoric) products

precision.initialisation: float32_cast: layers created in float32 under torch.manual_seed(seed), then cast
precision.inputs_and_basis: computed in float64 from the tables, cast to float32 for training
precision.property_tests: float64, trained weights cast to float64
precision.final_evaluation_metrics: float64, trained weights cast to float64
precision.float32_float64_consistency_check: max relative Frobenius difference of predictions <= 1e-4 for every trained model

training.final_refit_epochs: median of the inner-fold early-stopping epochs of the selected trial

tuning.selection_criterion: mean inner leave-one-out E_Pi (grid weights); test data never used
tuning.primary_estimate: mean over 3 tuning runs x 10 seeds of test E_Pi
tuning.secondary_estimate: the run with the lowest inner E_Pi of the three (reported, not used for claims)

statistics.effects: Delta_inv, Delta_con, Delta_int per fold (Section F.5)
statistics.uncertainty: hierarchical bootstrap, 4000 replicates: resample tuning runs (3), seeds within run (10), moving blocks of test points (10 % of profile), the same resample applied to all four models (paired)
statistics.tuning_dominated_if: |Delta| <= range of fold means across the 3 tuning runs of any model entering Delta; then reported descriptively
statistics.consistent_effect_if: same sign and resolved on at least 2 of 3 interpolation folds; extrapolation folds reported separately

ablations.hyperparameters: those selected by tuning run 1 (sampler seed 2026) of the parent model; no re-tuning; 10 seeds; E1 folds
ablations.A-soft: M3 with projection replaced by trace penalty, lambda in [1e-3,1e-2,1e-1,1,10,100]
ablations.A-scale: k/eps instead of the Durbin time scale, all four models
ablations.A-basis: M4 with a 3-element basis spanning everywhere on LM (chosen before training: T1, T2, T3)
ablations.A-inv-5: M2/M4 with the five-invariant set E4
ablations.A-lin: M4 with gradient-dependent coefficients restricted to be linear in grad U
ablations.A-aug: M1 trained on 8 random rotations of every training sample (M1 hyperparameters)

compute.hardware: 2-core Intel Xeon 2.1 GHz, 8 GB, CPU only
